limitations: These two fixed snapshots are distinct and precede later shared NMF/literature-recovery additions. They are not a single final-checkout sweep; exact later diffs are retained separately.

These full suites exercise contact enrichment, including weighted HIC and raw complete-empty data. They do not run a full episode path for insulation, weighted Cooler, or every reader edge case.
